name: Terraform Enterprise

install_scope.notes: Only the repositories selected at install time are available to workspaces, policy sets and registry modules.

manual_steps: Prefer Terraform Enterprise's own Admin > VCS Integrations > Create global GitHub App: it creates the app from a manifest with the webhook and callback URLs for your instance and stores the credentials.
If you create the app another way, use the webhook and callback URLs of your Terraform Enterprise instance.
notes: Terraform Enterprise doesn't support rotating the app's client secret, private key or webhook secret. Don't change the default permissions or events.
